    <title>0.126.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h2><a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/compare/0.125.1...0.126.0">0.126.0</a> (2026-11-18)</h2>
<h3>Before upgrading</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Derived metrics.</strong> Check string formulas in <code>derivedMetrics</code>. Arithmetic, comparisons, ternaries and score names such as <code>__count</code> still work. Function calls, property access, assignments and formulas longer than 1,024 characters now stop the evaluation before any test cases run. For example, replace <code>max(a, b)</code> with <code>a &gt; b ? a : b</code>. For more complex logic, use a function in a JavaScript config. <a href="https://www.promptfoo.dev/docs/configuration/expected-outputs/#mathematical-expressions" rel="nofollow">Formula syntax</a> · <a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/12125" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/12125/hovercard">#12125</a></li>
<li><strong>Full-repository code scans.</strong> Install and run Promptfoo with Node.js 24 or later for full scans. Diff-only scans still work on Node.js 22.22 or later. A full scan can share eligible committed text from the compared revision with the hosted scanner. Set <code>diffsOnly: true</code> in the code-scan configuration to share only the diff. <a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/12185" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/12185/hovercard">#12185</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Highlights</h3>
<ul>
<li>Evaluate GPT-6.2 Astra or Sol with <code>openai:gpt-6.2-astra</code> or <code>openai:gpt-6.2-sol</code>. Both use the Responses API by default. This release also adds Claude Fable and Mythos 5.2 and Gemini 4 Argon and Hydrogen. <a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/12474" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/12474/hovercard">#12474</a> · <a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/12358" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/12358/hovercard">#12358</a> · <a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/12416" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/12416/hovercard">#12416</a></li>
<li>Use <code>google:decisions:gemini-decision-1</code> to grade text, images, audio, video and PDFs. Gemini and Vertex also support file and live transcription. <a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/12393" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/12393/hovercard">#12393</a> · <a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/12151" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/12151/hovercard">#12151</a> ·
